description: This file defines the NoBracketingException class, an exception used in the Apache Commons Math library to indicate that a function does not have a bracketing interval with different signs at its endpoints.

classes.name: NoBracketingException
classes.description: An exception indicating that a function's values at the interval endpoints have the same sign, thus no bracketing interval exists.

methods.name: NoBracketingException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with interval bounds and function values.

methods.name: getLo
methods.description: Returns the lower end of the interval.

methods.name: getHi
methods.description: Returns the higher end of the interval.

methods.name: getFLo
methods.description: Returns the function value at the lower end of the interval.

methods.name: getFHi
methods.description: Returns the function value at the higher end of the interval.
